prompts.prompt: This repo has no instructions for AI coding agents, and half the team uses Claude Code while the other half uses Kiro. Write the project's AGENTS.md and whatever else is needed so both tools pick it up. Infer what you can from the repo. Write the files directly; no need to show me first. Do not ask me questions; make reasonable assumptions, mark inferred content as inferred, and finish the work.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill encodes runtime facts a competent model often gets wrong: Kiro does not expand @ or #[[file:]] imports in AGENTS.md, Claude Code reads only CLAUDE.md (so CLAUDE.md must contain @AGENTS.md), and context is loaded through a MUST-read Context Loading block. It also says to reference steering instead of copying it and not to dump memory into AGENTS.md. Without it, models typically write a good AGENTS.md with @ imports or copied style rules and no CLAUDE.md.

floor_checks.text: AGENTS.md uses no import directives (Kiro does not expand them)

rubric.pass: AGENTS.md has a '## Context Loading (MUST follow at session start)' block telling the agent to read .kiro/steering/**/*.md and .konductor/memory/*.md if present and skip missing paths; no import directives in AGENTS.md; CLAUDE.md contains @AGENTS.md; notes that Kiro agent specs must list file://AGENTS.md as a resource
rubric.partial: Context block and CLAUDE.md present but the Kiro resource requirement is not mentioned, or memory path missing
rubric.fail: Relies on @ imports in AGENTS.md, or no CLAUDE.md

rubric.pass: Overview (NOAA tide predictions library), structure (src/tidewatch, tests), commands from Makefile (make install with uv, make lint, make typecheck, make test) in CI order, Python >=3.11, ruff line length 100
rubric.partial: Commands right but structure or toolchain details missing
rubric.fail: Invented commands (e.g. npm, tox) or missing test command

rubric.criterion: Reference, don't duplicate; no memory dump
rubric.pass: Points to .kiro/steering/style.md rather than copying its rules; does not paste the timestamped MEMORY.md entry into AGENTS.md
rubric.partial: Copies one or two style rules or summarizes the memory fact
rubric.fail: Copies the style file wholesale or pastes memory entries

rubric.pass: Has Overview, Structure, Setup & Commands, Code Style, Testing, Workflow; workflow/PR conventions not visible in the repo are labeled inferred or left as a placeholder
rubric.partial: Sections present but inferred items stated as fact

prompts.prompt: Our AGENTS.md pulls steering and memory in with @ imports, but the Kiro agent (.kiro/agents/invoicer-dev.json) never seems to follow any of it, while Claude Code does. Fix things so both Kiro and Claude Code load the same context, and write a short explanation of the root cause and the fix to agents-fix-notes.md. Do not ask me questions; make reasonable assumptions, list them in the notes, and finish the work.
prompts.why_discriminating: The skill's loading table explains two separate causes: Kiro does not expand imports in AGENTS.md, and Kiro does not auto-read AGENTS.md unless the agent lists file://AGENTS.md as a resource. The fixture's agent spec only lists steering. A competent model without the skill usually fixes one cause (often just the imports) and the Kiro agent stays blind to AGENTS.md.
